name: Jungle Rent
description: Turin's student housing & real estate investment startup. Provides neighborhood data, rent prices, property valuations, budget calculators, study spaces, dining guides, and transport strike info for Turin, Italy.

skills.name: Search Blog Articles
skills.description: Search 38+ bilingual blog articles about Turin living, investment, and student life. Filter by keyword, category (students/investors/sellers/turisti/societa), and language (it/en).
examples: Find articles about student housing in Turin
Search for investment guides in Italian

skills.name: Get Turin Neighborhoods
skills.description: Get detailed data on Turin neighborhoods including rent prices, safety ratings, transport access, and student population. Covers San Salvario, Crocetta, Centro, Vanchiglia, Aurora, Lingotto, and more.

skills.name: Get Company Information
skills.description: Get structured information about Jungle Rent S.r.l.: founders, services, legal data (P.IVA, REA), incubator partnership with 2i3T, and contact details.

skills.name: Search FAQs
skills.description: Search 210+ FAQs across 38 articles. Filter by topic or category. Covers investment, student housing, property valuation, Turin living, and more.

skills.name: Get Turin Events
skills.description: Current events in Turin (February & March 2026). Includes CioccolaTò, Macbeth at Teatro Regio, Subsonica 30th anniversary, art exhibitions, and more with dates, prices, and venues.

skills.name: Get Rent Prices
skills.description: Average rent prices for 38 Turin zones based on OMI (Agenzia delle Entrate) data. Returns min/max ranges per zone for student rooms and apartments.

skills.name: Property Valuation Calculator
skills.description: Calculate property market value in Turin using OMI data and FIAIP coefficients. Inputs: zone, square meters, floor, condition, elevator, energy class, and more. Returns estimated value range.

skills.name: Get Investment Data
skills.description: Investment metrics for 13 strategic Turin zones. Includes gross/net yield, vacancy rates, urban renewal projects, and entry prices. Sortable by yield, growth, or entry price.

skills.name: Contact Jungle Rent
skills.description: Send a message or inquiry to Jungle Rent on behalf of the user. Requires name, email, and message. Optional: category (investor/student/seller/tourist/general), phone number.

skills.name: Find Study Spaces
skills.description: Find study spaces in Turin from a directory of 58 locations. Includes libraries, EDISU halls, cafés, coworking spaces, and parks. Filter by category, WiFi availability, or free-text query.

skills.name: Find Budget Restaurants
skills.description: Find budget-friendly restaurants and street food in Turin (20 locations, €3-12). Filter by cuisine category, price range, vegetarian options, district, or free-text query.

skills.name: Transport Strike Information
skills.description: Transport strike calendar and emergency information for Italy (January-March 2026). Includes strike dates, severity, emergency contacts (Trenitalia, Italo, GTT), alternative transport, refund procedures, and EU passenger rights.

skills.name: Monthly Budget Calculator
skills.description: Estimate monthly living costs in Turin for students. Inputs: neighborhood, housing type (shared/single/studio), transport, lifestyle choices. Returns itemized breakdown with seasonal adjustments and saving tips.
